instruction.text: Choose whether the example represents progress or failure of women's rights initiatives.

atoms.text:
Roe v. Wade
A US Supreme Court decision that legalised abortion in 1973. It was overturned in 2022, allowing US states to pass more restrictive laws on abortion and reigniting debates on reproductive rights.

Succession to the Crown Act 2013
A British law ensuring that sons and daughters have equal rights to inherit the throne regardless of gender.

atoms.text:
#MeToo movement
A global campaign where people, especially women, share experiences of sexual harassment to raise awareness and demand accountability.
